cases.name: legacy-v1
cases.what: a project from before the rename (its own directory and format, schema 1)

cases.name: legacy-v1-torn-tail
cases.what: a project from before the rename whose last journal write was cut off (a crash of the earlier release)

cases.name: historical-v2
cases.what: project schema 2, from before journal segments

cases.name: current-v3-segments
cases.what: project schema 3 with an archived journal segment

cases.name: recoverable-torn-tail
cases.what: a journal whose last write was cut off

cases.name: recoverable-stale-temporary
cases.what: a temporary file left by an interrupted save

expect.pattern: project schema 4 is newer than supported schema 3
is document schema 2, newer than supported schema 1

cases.name: future-journal-operation
cases.what: a correctly chained journal entry with an operation this release does not know

expect.pattern: uses operation type "morph-node", which journal format 1 does not have

cases.name: corrupt-journal-chain
cases.what: a journal entry changed after it was written

expect.pattern: journal line 1 breaks the hash chain

cases.name: corrupt-document-object
cases.what: a document object whose bytes no longer match its name

expect.pattern: object [0-9a-f]{64} does not match its content hash

cases.name: corrupt-missing-object
cases.what: a document object that is gone

cases.name: corrupt-snapshot
cases.what: a snapshot reference that is not JSON

expect.pattern: snapshot reference is not valid JSON

cases.name: corrupt-snapshot-past-end
cases.what: a snapshot reference past the end of the journal

expect.pattern: snapshot reference points past the end of the journal

cases.name: corrupt-manifest
cases.what: a manifest that is not JSON

cases.name: corrupt-object-fan-out
cases.what: an object fan-out folder that is a file (Windows reports it as missing, so the store checks)

expect.pattern: object fan-out directory is not a directory

cases.name: legacy-v1-future-schema
cases.what: a project from before the rename, of a newer schema than any release wrote

expect.pattern: project schema 4 is newer than supported schema 3

cases.name: legacy-v1-corrupt-chain
cases.what: a project from before the rename with a journal entry changed after it was written

expect.pattern: journal line 1 breaks the hash chain
